title: Falling in Love
summary: Falling in love brings intense attraction, excitement and focus on one person, driven partly by brain chemicals like dopamine. Over time, passionate love often deepens into calmer companionate love.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
